_about: Limits for scripts/perf-budget.cjs: highest of several local runs (2026-11-16, wave 8, 25 live zombies, 1280x720) plus about 10%. Zombie variants are random, so nodes and casters wobble by about 1% between runs. Exceptions: lightsTotal and lightsVisible are EXACT (CLAUDE.md fixes the light count). programs is the highest reading over the frame, after a real shot and after swapping through every weapon. Raise a limit only on purpose, in the same PR as the change that needs it, and say why. 2026-11-17: zombies are now about 6 merged part meshes (t-zombie-merge). Triangles rose (merged caster parts render every box in the shadow pass, about 33k for 25 zombies, trivial for a GPU) so the limit went up to 55,000; draws, nodes and meshes fell, so their limits were tightened to lock the gain in.
